name: reez-rust-output
author: Reez contributors
description: Translate completed EEZ C build outputs to equivalent Rust source

eez-studio.moreDescription: C-output backend: converts generated C files with C2Rust/Clang. Windows uses a local x64 WSL backend (Python 3.11+; Cargo for compile checks). Supply the real compile_commands.json for target-specific headers and macros. No project/widget whitelist.
